definition: This market covers shrimp farming systems that produce very high quantities of shrimp in a relatively small area by using high stocking densities and intensive farm management.
inclusions: Farming systems: super-intensive ponds, raceways, lined ponds, controlled shrimp farms; Technology: intensive aeration, water circulation, monitoring; Species: shrimp.
exclusions: Traditional/extensive shrimp farming, shrimp hatcheries, shrimp feed, shrimp processing, wild-caught shrimp.

definition: This market covers aquaculture systems that use beneficial microorganisms to recycle waste in the water and maintain better water quality for fish or shrimp.
inclusions: Systems: biofloc ponds, tanks, raceways; Products: microbial cultures, biofloc additives; Equipment: aeration, water monitoring and circulation systems.
exclusions: Conventional aquaculture ponds, RAS without biofloc technology, general probiotics not used for biofloc systems.

definition: This market covers fish and aquatic-animal farming systems where water is continuously cleaned and reused instead of being regularly discharged and replaced.
inclusions: Equipment: tanks, pumps, filters, biofilters, UV, ozone, oxygenation; Systems: complete RAS farms; Applications: fish, shrimp and other aquatic species.
exclusions: Open ponds, cages, conventional flow-through systems, standalone industrial water-treatment systems.

definition: This market covers aquaculture systems where different aquatic species are farmed together so that the waste or nutrients from one species can be used by another.
inclusions: Species combinations: fish + shellfish, fish + seaweed, shrimp + seaweed; Systems: integrated production farms and supporting equipment.
exclusions: Single-species aquaculture, conventional polyculture without nutrient integration, seafood processing.

definition: This market covers farming of fish, shellfish or other aquatic species in marine areas located away from the immediate coastline.
inclusions: Infrastructure: offshore cages, pens, mooring systems, feeding systems; Species: finfish, shellfish and seaweed; Services: offshore farm management.
exclusions: Inland aquaculture, land-based farms, nearshore farming and wild fishing.

definition: This market covers fish and aquatic-animal farming carried out on land using tanks, ponds or controlled water systems.
inclusions: Systems: tanks, raceways, RAS, land-based ponds; Species: fish, shrimp and other aquatic animals; Infrastructure: water treatment, filtration and aeration.
exclusions: Offshore cages, marine fishing, seafood processing and hatchery-only operations.

definition: This market covers businesses and systems that breed shrimp and produce young shrimp for stocking commercial farms.
inclusions: Stages: broodstock, spawning, larval rearing, nursery and post-larvae; Products: shrimp seed/post-larvae; Equipment: hatchery tanks, filtration and water-management systems.
exclusions: Shrimp grow-out farms, shrimp feed, shrimp processing and wild shrimp fishing.

definition: This market covers facilities that breed fish and produce young fish for stocking in commercial aquaculture farms.
inclusions: Stages: broodstock, eggs, larvae, fry and fingerlings; Species: freshwater, marine and ornamental/commercial fish; Equipment: incubators, tanks and hatchery systems.
exclusions: Fish grow-out farms, fishing, fish feed and fish processing.

definition: This market covers technologies and breeding programs used to develop better-performing fish and shrimp varieties.
inclusions: Services: selective breeding, genetic testing, genomic selection; Products: improved broodstock and genetic lines; Traits: growth, survival, disease resistance and feed efficiency.
exclusions: General hatchery operations, vaccines, feed and disease treatments.

definition: This market covers fish and shrimp varieties specifically developed or selected to better resist common diseases.
inclusions: Species: disease-resistant shrimp, fish and other aquatic species; Technologies: selective breeding, genetic selection and resistant broodstock.
exclusions: Regular aquaculture species, vaccines, antibiotics, diagnostics and disease-treatment products.

definition: This market covers vaccines used to protect farmed fish and other aquatic animals against infectious diseases.
inclusions: Vaccine types: injectable, oral and immersion vaccines; Diseases: bacterial, viral and other infectious diseases; Species: fish and other farmed aquatic animals.
exclusions: Antibiotics, probiotics, immunostimulants, diagnostics and vaccines for terrestrial animals.

definition: This market covers beneficial microorganisms used in aquaculture to improve animal health, digestion and/or water quality.
inclusions: Products: bacterial probiotics, yeast-based products, microbial blends; Applications: animal gut health, pond water management and feed supplementation.
exclusions: Antibiotics, vaccines, chemical disinfectants and non-microbial feed additives.

definition: This market covers products added to aquaculture diets or systems to help fish and shrimp naturally strengthen their immune response.
inclusions: Products: beta-glucans, nucleotides, herbal extracts and immune-support additives; Applications: feed-based and water-based immune support.
exclusions: Vaccines, antibiotics, ordinary feed ingredients and products primarily sold as probiotics.

definition: This market covers fish and shrimp feeds designed to provide additional health or performance benefits beyond basic nutrition.
inclusions: Feed types: immune-support feed, gut-health feed, stress-management feed, growth-enhancing feed; Species: fish, shrimp and other aquaculture species.
exclusions: Commodity feed, standalone feed additives, vaccines and veterinary medicines.

definition: This market covers aquaculture feeds that use newer protein sources instead of relying mainly on traditional fishmeal and other conventional proteins.
inclusions: Protein sources: plant proteins, microbial proteins, fermentation proteins, insect proteins and novel proteins; Products: ingredients and complete feeds.
exclusions: Conventional fishmeal/fish oil and feeds without alternative-protein content.

definition: This market covers fish and shrimp feed made using protein or oil obtained from insects.
inclusions: Sources: black soldier fly, mealworm and other insects; Products: insect meal, insect oil, insect-based feed; Applications: fish and shrimp nutrition.
exclusions: Fishmeal, plant protein, algae protein and other non-insect alternative proteins.

definition: This market covers feed ingredients and feeds made using algae to provide protein, oil, pigments or other nutritional benefits.
inclusions: Sources: microalgae, macroalgae; Products: algal protein, algal oil, pigments and algae-based feed formulations.
exclusions: Insect protein, fishmeal, conventional plant protein and non-feed algae applications.

definition: This market covers products specifically used to improve digestion and the balance of beneficial microorganisms in shrimp.
inclusions: Products: probiotics, prebiotics, postbiotics, enzymes and gut-health additives; Applications: feed and pond-based gut-health management.
exclusions: General shrimp feed, vaccines, antibiotics, water-treatment products and non-gut-health products.

definition: This market covers products and equipment used to keep water clean and suitable for fish and shrimp farming.
inclusions: Products/equipment: filters, biofilters, UV, ozone, aerators, oxygen systems, water conditioners and treatment chemicals; Applications: ponds, tanks and RAS.
exclusions: Municipal water treatment, industrial wastewater treatment and unrelated water-treatment equipment.

definition: This market covers products and systems used to prevent diseases from entering or spreading within fish and shrimp farms.
inclusions: Products: disinfectants, sanitation products, quarantine systems, protective equipment, pathogen-control systems and biosecurity monitoring.
exclusions: Vaccines, general water treatment, therapeutic medicines and ordinary farm equipment.

definition: This market covers products used to reduce the risk of diseases occurring or spreading in farmed aquatic animals.
inclusions: Products: preventive health products, probiotics, immunostimulants, disinfectants and prophylactic solutions; Applications: fish and shrimp farming.
exclusions: Disease diagnostics, treatment-only medicines and general farm equipment.

definition: This market covers aquaculture species and farming systems designed to continue performing under changing temperatures, water conditions and other climate-related stresses.
inclusions: Species: heat-tolerant/drought- or salinity-tolerant varieties; Systems: climate-adapted farms, water-saving systems and temperature management.
exclusions: Conventional aquaculture without climate-resilience features.

definition: This market covers aquaculture production systems and technologies designed to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions from farming operations.
inclusions: Solutions: renewable energy, energy-efficient equipment, low-carbon feeds, efficient water systems and emissions-reduction technologies.
exclusions: General sustainable aquaculture products without a specific carbon/emission focus.

definition: This market covers farming practices and technologies designed to make aquaculture more environmentally and resource efficient.
inclusions: Areas: water efficiency, sustainable feed, energy efficiency, responsible farming, waste reduction and resource recycling.
exclusions: Conventional aquaculture without sustainability attributes and downstream seafood processing.

definition: This market covers seafood products that have been processed beyond basic cleaning or primary handling to create higher-value products.
inclusions: Products: fillets, frozen portions, smoked seafood, canned seafood, breaded seafood, ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat seafood.
exclusions: Live seafood, primary aquaculture production, hatcheries, feed and raw seafood trading.

definition: This market covers poultry feeds that provide additional health, growth or performance benefits beyond basic nutrition.
inclusions: Feed types: gut-health, immunity-support, stress-management and performance feeds; Birds: broilers, layers and breeders.
exclusions: Standard/commodity poultry feed, standalone additives and veterinary medicines.

market: Alternative Protein for Poultry Feed Market
definition: This market covers newer protein sources used to reduce dependence on conventional poultry-feed proteins.
inclusions: Sources: plant alternatives, microbial proteins, fermentation proteins, insect proteins and other novel proteins.
exclusions: Conventional soybean meal, fishmeal and standard protein ingredients.

definition: This market covers poultry feed ingredients and feeds made using insect-derived protein or oil.
inclusions: Sources: black soldier fly, mealworm and other insects; Products: insect meal, insect oil and finished poultry feed.
exclusions: Conventional plant protein, fishmeal and other alternative proteins.

definition: This market covers beneficial microorganisms added to poultry feed or drinking water to support bird health and digestion.
inclusions: Products: bacterial probiotics, yeast probiotics and multi-strain products; Applications: broilers, layers and breeders.
exclusions: Antibiotics, vaccines, prebiotics and non-microbial additives.

definition: This market covers products made from non-living microorganisms or their useful components that are used to support poultry health.
inclusions: Products: microbial metabolites, inactivated microorganisms and microbial cell components; Applications: feed and drinking water.
exclusions: Live probiotics, antibiotics and conventional vitamins/minerals.

definition: This market covers products used to maintain a healthy digestive system and microbial balance in poultry.
inclusions: Products: probiotics, prebiotics, postbiotics, enzymes and organic acids; Applications: broilers, layers and breeders.
exclusions: Vaccines, general feed and products without a gut-health purpose.

definition: This market covers vaccines used to protect chickens and other commercial poultry against infectious diseases.
inclusions: Types: live, killed/inactivated, recombinant and other vaccines; Birds: broilers, layers and breeders.
exclusions: Antibiotics, probiotics, diagnostics and livestock vaccines.

definition: This market covers products used to prevent diseases from entering poultry farms and spreading between birds or farms.
inclusions: Products: disinfectants, sanitation products, protective clothing, entry-control systems and biosecurity monitoring.
exclusions: Vaccines, medicines and general poultry equipment.

definition: This market covers products used to reduce the risk of diseases occurring in poultry farms.
inclusions: Products: preventive health products, probiotics, immunostimulants, disinfectants and prophylactic solutions.
exclusions: Diagnostic products and medicines primarily used to treat an existing disease.

market: Poultry Heat Stress Management Products Market
definition: This market covers products and systems that help poultry cope with high temperatures and reduce heat-related productivity losses.
inclusions: Products: electrolytes, supplements, cooling systems, ventilation, fogging and environmental-control systems.
exclusions: General poultry housing equipment without heat-stress functionality.

definition: This market covers commercial farming of chickens primarily for the production of table eggs.
inclusions: Systems: layer farms, cage-free systems, cage systems and free-range layer systems; Output: commercial eggs.
exclusions: Broiler meat production, hatcheries and egg-processing products.

definition: This market covers commercial farming of chickens raised primarily for meat production.
inclusions: Systems: broiler farms, housing, feeding, environmental control and farm operations.
exclusions: Layer farms, hatcheries and processed poultry meat.

definition: This market covers poultry farming where birds are provided access to outdoor areas under defined free-range production practices.
inclusions: Birds: chickens and other poultry; Products: free-range eggs and meat; Systems: outdoor-access farms.
exclusions: Conventional indoor farming and organic farming unless specifically meeting free-range criteria.

definition: This market covers poultry farming operated according to recognized organic production standards.
inclusions: Products: organic eggs and poultry meat; Systems: organic feed, organic farm management and certified organic production.
exclusions: Conventional farming and free-range farming without organic standards/certification.

definition: This market covers facilities, equipment and services used to hatch eggs and produce day-old chicks for poultry farms.
inclusions: Equipment: incubators, hatchers, egg handling and chick processing; Services: hatchery operations; Output: day-old chicks.
exclusions: Broiler/layer farming, poultry feed and meat/egg processing.

definition: This market covers birds specifically maintained for breeding and producing commercial poultry offspring.
inclusions: Birds: parent stock, grandparent stock and breeder birds; Services: breeder management and genetic programs.
exclusions: Commercial broilers/layers, hatchery equipment and ordinary poultry birds.

definition: This market covers genetic technologies and breeding programs used to improve poultry characteristics such as growth, egg production and disease resistance.
inclusions: Technologies: genetic testing, genomic selection and breeding programs; Outputs: improved genetic lines.
exclusions: General hatchery operations, feed and vaccines.

definition: This market covers semen technologies that allow livestock producers to increase the chances of producing offspring of a desired sex.
inclusions: Products: sex-sorted semen; Technologies: semen sorting and processing; Applications: cattle and other livestock breeding.
exclusions: Conventional semen, poultry hatcheries and unrelated reproductive technologies.

definition: This market covers products and services used to improve and manage reproduction in farm animals.
inclusions: Products/services: artificial insemination, estrus synchronization, reproductive hormones, pregnancy monitoring and breeding management.
exclusions: General veterinary medicines and non-reproductive animal health products.

definition: This market covers data-based feeding solutions that help dairy farmers provide the right amount and type of feed to animals.
inclusions: Solutions: precision feeding, ration formulation, feed-monitoring systems, nutritional software and animal sensors.
exclusions: General dairy feed, conventional feed formulation and non-dairy livestock nutrition.

definition: This market covers beneficial microorganisms added to livestock feed or water to support digestion, animal health and performance.
inclusions: Animals: cattle, dairy, swine, sheep and goats; Products: bacterial/yeast probiotics and microbial blends.
exclusions: Poultry-specific probiotics, antibiotics, vaccines and conventional feed ingredients.

definition: This market covers products and technologies designed specifically to reduce methane emissions from livestock.
inclusions: Solutions: methane-reducing feed additives, rumen modifiers, dietary solutions, methane monitoring and emission-management systems.
exclusions: General livestock sustainability products without methane-reduction objectives.

definition: This market covers feed additives that provide specific health, digestion, performance or productivity benefits to livestock.
inclusions: Additives: enzymes, phytogenics, organic acids, yeast products, immune-support products and gut-health additives.
exclusions: Basic feed ingredients, veterinary drugs and poultry-specific additives.

definition: This market covers livestock production systems and animal varieties designed to perform better under changing climate conditions.
inclusions: Solutions: heat-tolerant breeds, cooling systems, climate-adapted housing, water-management systems and resilient genetics.
exclusions: Conventional livestock production without climate-adaptation features.

definition: This market covers commercial farming of livestock species outside the major mainstream cattle, poultry and pig categories.
inclusions: Animals: goats, sheep, rabbits, camels, deer and other specialty livestock; Systems: breeding, farming and production.
exclusions: Mainstream cattle, poultry and pig farming.

definition: This market covers products applied to crops or soil to help plants grow better, use nutrients more efficiently or handle stress.
inclusions: Products: seaweed extracts, humic substances, amino acids, microbial and non-microbial biostimulants; Applications: seed, soil and foliar.
exclusions: Conventional fertilizers, pesticides and seeds without biostimulant functionality.

definition: This market covers beneficial microorganisms used to improve plant growth, nutrient use and tolerance to environmental stress.
inclusions: Microbes: bacteria, fungi and microbial blends; Applications: seed, soil and root treatment.
exclusions: Chemical biostimulants, microbial pesticides and conventional biofertilizers where nutrient supply is the primary purpose.

definition: This market covers products containing two or more beneficial microorganisms that work together to support crops or soil.
inclusions: Products: bacterial consortia, fungal consortia and bacteria-fungi combinations; Applications: soil, seed and crop treatment.
exclusions: Single-microbe products and non-agricultural microbial products.

definition: This market covers products containing beneficial microorganisms that help crops obtain nutrients naturally.
inclusions: Products: Rhizobium, Azotobacter, Azospirillum, phosphate-solubilizing bacteria, mycorrhizae; Applications: seed and soil.
exclusions: Chemical fertilizers, pesticides and non-nutritional biostimulants.

definition: This market covers newer biological fertilizer solutions designed to provide nutrients more efficiently than traditional biofertilizers.
inclusions: Technologies: novel microbes, microbial consortia, advanced formulations, engineered/selected strains and advanced delivery systems.
exclusions: Conventional biofertilizers and chemical fertilizers.

definition: This market covers naturally derived or biological products used to protect crops from insects, diseases and other pests.
inclusions: Products: microbial pesticides, botanicals, biological control agents, pheromones and other biological crop-protection products.
exclusions: Synthetic chemical pesticides and fertilizers.

definition: This market covers microorganisms used to control insects, plant diseases and other agricultural pests.
inclusions: Microbes: bacteria, fungi, viruses and other microorganisms; Applications: insect, fungal and other pest control.
exclusions: Chemical pesticides, biofertilizers and microbial products used only for plant nutrition.

definition: This market covers crop-protection products that use RNA technology to target specific pests or pathogens.
inclusions: Technologies: dsRNA, RNA interference and RNA delivery systems; Applications: insect and pathogen control.
exclusions: Conventional pesticides, gene-edited crops and non-agricultural RNA products.

definition: This market covers pesticides made primarily from plants or plant-derived substances.
inclusions: Products: neem, pyrethrum, essential oils and other botanical extracts; Applications: insect, fungal and pest control.
exclusions: Synthetic pesticides and microbial biopesticides.

definition: This market covers biological products applied to seeds to improve early plant growth or protect seeds and seedlings from pests and diseases.
inclusions: Products: microbial inoculants, biological protectants, biostimulant coatings and biological seed treatments.
exclusions: Chemical seed treatments and foliar crop-protection products.

definition: This market covers seeds designed to help crops maintain productivity under difficult climate conditions.
inclusions: Traits: heat, drought, salinity, flood and other climate-tolerance traits; Products: commercial seeds and improved varieties.
exclusions: Conventional seeds without documented climate-resilience traits.

definition: This market covers crops developed by making targeted changes to their genes to improve specific characteristics.
inclusions: Technologies: CRISPR and other gene-editing methods; Traits: yield, nutrition, disease resistance and stress tolerance.
exclusions: Conventional breeding and crops developed only through traditional genetic modification.

definition: This market covers crop varieties that can maintain growth and productivity when water availability is low.
inclusions: Crops: drought-tolerant seeds and varieties; Technologies: breeding, genetic improvement and related crop technologies.
exclusions: General climate-resilient crops without drought-specific characteristics.

definition: This market covers crop varieties that can grow and produce crops in soils or irrigation water with higher salt levels.
inclusions: Crops: salt-tolerant seeds and varieties; Technologies: breeding and genetic improvement.
exclusions: Drought-tolerant crops without salinity tolerance and general soil-management products.

definition: This market covers products that use naturally occurring viruses called bacteriophages to control harmful bacteria affecting crops.
inclusions: Products: phage formulations, phage mixtures and phage-based crop-protection products; Applications: bacterial crop diseases.
exclusions: Chemical bactericides, fungal biocontrols and non-agricultural phage products.

definition: This market covers farming practices and solutions aimed at improving soil health, biodiversity and long-term farm productivity.
inclusions: Practices: cover crops, reduced tillage, crop rotation, biological inputs, soil restoration and regenerative farm-management programs.
exclusions: Conventional farming without regenerative practices.

definition: This market covers farming practices and programs designed to capture more carbon in agricultural systems or reduce farm-related emissions.
inclusions: Activities: soil carbon, agroforestry, reduced tillage, carbon projects, carbon measurement and carbon credits.
exclusions: Sustainability activities without a carbon objective.

definition: This market covers products, services and programs specifically focused on measuring and increasing the amount of carbon stored in agricultural soil.
inclusions: Segments: soil-carbon measurement, monitoring, reporting and verification; carbon-enhancing practices; soil-carbon projects.
exclusions: Carbon stored in forests, industrial carbon capture and agricultural sustainability activities without soil-carbon focus.

definition: This market covers farming systems and technologies designed to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions from crop production.
inclusions: Solutions: efficient fertilizers, renewable energy, efficient irrigation, low-emission machinery and reduced-tillage systems.
exclusions: General sustainable agriculture without a carbon-reduction objective.

definition: This market covers products used to improve the physical, chemical or biological condition of agricultural soil.
inclusions: Products: soil conditioners, organic amendments, microbial products, compost-based products and soil-health enhancers.
exclusions: Conventional fertilizers and pesticides without soil-health positioning.

definition: This market covers beneficial microorganisms added to soil, seeds or plant roots to improve soil and plant performance.
inclusions: Microbes: mycorrhizae, nitrogen-fixing bacteria, phosphate-solubilizing microbes and other soil inoculants.
exclusions: Chemical fertilizers, non-microbial soil conditioners and microbial pesticides.

definition: This market covers technologies and farming practices that help farmers produce crops using less water.
inclusions: Solutions: drip irrigation, precision irrigation, soil-moisture management, water-saving cultivation and crop-water optimization.
exclusions: Conventional irrigation without water-efficiency functionality.

definition: This market covers crop production where farmers actively control growing conditions such as temperature, humidity, light, water and nutrients.
inclusions: Systems: greenhouses, vertical farms, indoor farms, hydroponics and aeroponics.
exclusions: Open-field agriculture and basic protected cultivation without environmental control.

definition: This market covers systems where agricultural production and solar power generation take place on the same land.
inclusions: Systems: solar panels above crops, elevated solar structures, crop-compatible PV systems and farm-energy systems.
exclusions: Conventional solar farms without agricultural production.

definition: This market covers technologies that turn agricultural waste and residues into useful or saleable products instead of simply disposing of them.
inclusions: Inputs: crop residues, husks, stalks, animal/agricultural waste; Outputs: bioenergy, biochar, fertilizers, feed, biomaterials and chemicals.
exclusions: Conventional waste disposal and waste collection without value recovery.

definition: This market covers AI tools that can create text, reports, recommendations, images or other outputs to help farmers and agricultural businesses.
inclusions: Applications: farm advisory, report generation, knowledge assistants, crop recommendations, content generation and agricultural analytics.
exclusions: Traditional analytics, rule-based software and AI systems that only predict/classify without generative capabilities.

definition: This market covers AI systems that can independently plan and carry out multiple agricultural tasks rather than only providing information.
inclusions: Applications: autonomous planning, farm workflows, procurement, crop management, monitoring and decision execution.
exclusions: Basic chatbots, conventional AI prediction tools and static analytics.

definition: This market covers camera-based technologies that identify and monitor crops, plants, pests, diseases, animals or farm activities.
inclusions: Applications: crop inspection, disease detection, fruit counting, weed identification, livestock monitoring and quality inspection.
exclusions: Conventional cameras without agricultural analytics.

definition: This market covers software platforms that connect agricultural devices and bring their data together for monitoring and management.
inclusions: Platforms: device management, data collection, dashboards, cloud platforms, IoT analytics and device integration.
exclusions: Individual sensors, connectivity hardware and generic IoT platforms without agricultural applications.

definition: This market covers physical devices that measure conditions such as soil, weather, crops, animals or farm equipment.
inclusions: Sensors: soil moisture, temperature, humidity, pH, nutrients, weather, crop and livestock sensors.
exclusions: Generic consumer sensors and agricultural software without sensor hardware.

definition: This market covers systems that continuously or digitally monitor soil conditions to help farmers understand when and how to manage their fields.
inclusions: Sensors: moisture, pH, EC, nutrients and temperature; Solutions: monitoring devices, gateways, dashboards and soil analytics.
exclusions: Laboratory-only soil testing and general weather-monitoring systems.

definition: This market covers irrigation systems that automatically decide or adjust when and how much water should be supplied to crops.
inclusions: Systems: automated drip, sprinkler, smart controllers, soil-moisture-based irrigation, weather-based irrigation, smart valves and irrigation software.
exclusions: Manual irrigation, conventional irrigation equipment and pumps without smart controls.

definition: This market covers drones specifically used to monitor, map, spray or perform other tasks on farms.
inclusions: Drone types: spraying drones, mapping drones, scouting drones and fixed-wing/multirotor agricultural UAVs.
exclusions: Consumer drones and drones used for non-agricultural applications.

definition: This market covers agricultural drones that can perform missions with little or no continuous manual control.
inclusions: Applications: autonomous spraying, crop scouting, mapping, navigation and mission planning.
exclusions: Manually controlled agricultural drones.

definition: This market covers robots that perform agricultural tasks such as planting, weeding, monitoring, picking or handling crops.
inclusions: Robots: field robots, weeding robots, robotic arms, scouting robots and crop-handling robots.
exclusions: Conventional farm machinery without robotic functionality.

definition: This market covers farm machinery that can perform field operations with limited human intervention.
inclusions: Equipment: autonomous tractors, harvesters, planters and autonomous implements; Technology: navigation, sensors and control systems.
exclusions: Conventional manually operated tractors and machinery.

definition: This market covers robots specifically designed to identify, pick and collect crops during harvesting.
inclusions: Systems: robotic arms, machine vision, autonomous picking machines and crop-handling robots.
exclusions: Conventional mechanical harvesters and post-harvest processing equipment.

definition: This market covers agricultural monitoring services that use satellite images and satellite data to understand farm and crop conditions.
inclusions: Applications: crop health, acreage mapping, yield monitoring, crop forecasting and farm monitoring.
exclusions: Drone-based monitoring and ground-based monitoring systems.

definition: This market covers technologies that collect information about crops, soil and farms from a distance rather than through direct physical measurement.
inclusions: Technologies: satellite, aerial imaging, multispectral, hyperspectral, LiDAR and other remote-sensing technologies.
exclusions: Ground sensors, laboratory testing and manual field inspection.

market: Synthetic Aperture Radar for Agriculture Market
definition: This market covers radar-based satellite technology used to monitor agricultural land and crops, including when clouds make optical imaging difficult.
inclusions: Solutions: SAR imagery, soil-moisture monitoring, crop monitoring, field mapping and SAR analytics.
exclusions: Optical satellite imagery, conventional agricultural radar and non-agricultural SAR applications.

definition: This market covers digital models of farms, crops, equipment or production systems that are updated using real-world data.
inclusions: Models: farm twins, crop twins, equipment twins and production-system simulations; Applications: monitoring and scenario analysis.
exclusions: Static farm maps, basic dashboards and conventional farm-management software.

definition: This market covers software platforms that bring different agricultural data, tools and farm-management functions together in one digital environment.
inclusions: Functions: farm management, crop monitoring, analytics, IoT integration, planning and decision support.
exclusions: Single-purpose agricultural software and hardware-only products.

definition: This market covers online platforms where agricultural data can be discovered, exchanged, licensed or purchased.
inclusions: Data: weather, soil, crop, satellite, farm, commodity and agricultural supply-chain datasets; Services: data licensing and exchange.
exclusions: Internal company databases and standard farm-management software.

definition: This market covers software used by farmers and farm businesses to plan, record and manage day-to-day agricultural operations.
inclusions: Functions: crop planning, field records, inventory, labor, financial management, compliance and farm reporting.
exclusions: Standalone accounting software, sensor hardware and non-farm enterprise software.

definition: This market covers communication technologies that connect farm equipment, sensors, workers and digital platforms.
inclusions: Technologies: cellular, 4G/5G, LPWAN, LoRaWAN, satellite connectivity, private networks and farm gateways.
exclusions: General telecom services without an agricultural application.

definition: This market covers blockchain systems used to track agricultural products from farms through processing and distribution.
inclusions: Applications: product traceability, provenance, transaction records, smart contracts and farm-to-consumer tracking.
exclusions: Conventional databases and blockchain applications unrelated to agriculture.

definition: This market covers cybersecurity solutions designed to protect connected farms, agricultural software, machinery and farm data.
inclusions: Solutions: network security, endpoint security, OT security, identity management, threat monitoring and data protection.
exclusions: Physical farm security and general IT cybersecurity without agricultural application.

definition: This market covers software that uses agricultural data to provide farmers with recommendations for making better operational decisions.
inclusions: Applications: crop selection, planting, irrigation, disease prediction, fertilization, pest management and yield forecasting.
exclusions: Raw data platforms, basic dashboards and general farm-management software without decision-support functionality.

definition: This market covers technologies that allow farmers to apply different amounts of seed, fertilizer, pesticides or other inputs to different parts of a field.
inclusions: Applications: variable-rate seeding, fertilizer, pesticide and irrigation; Technologies: GPS, GIS, prescription maps and rate controllers.
exclusions: Uniform-rate application equipment and precision-farming software without variable-rate application.

definition: This market covers computing technologies that process agricultural data close to the farm equipment or sensors instead of sending all data to a distant cloud server.
inclusions: Solutions: edge gateways, edge servers, on-device AI, local analytics and edge-processing hardware/software.
exclusions: Conventional cloud computing, standalone sensors and data centers without agricultural edge applications.
